original_analysis: Use selected_for_variants=1 without changing the first-100 BAM-order subset; reproduce original metric definitions before claiming agreement.
full_population: All saved truth-overlapping primary-read records in each provider-supplied processed bundle; not all originally sequenced molecules.

sampling.rank: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical compact JSON [seed,sample_id,run_id,contig,read_id], lexicographically ascending digest then key; no scores or labels in rank.
sampling.selection_frame: Unique reads represented in existing truth-overlap tables; no filtering by probability or alignment eligibility. If fewer than 100, include all and report count. Retain all target records for each selected read.
sampling.limitation: Reads without any saved truth overlap cannot be sampled without BAM reprocessing and are outside this authorized supplementary frame. Fixed seeds are not independent biological replicates.

conditions.canonical: Observed explicit m6A midpoint on MATCHED_READ_SITE records only; missing p remains missing.
conditions.site_mean_as_read: Within each selected sample/contig/ref_pos0 site, average existing explicit p and repeat this mean on those explicit records, preserving the original controlled case definition; diagnostic invalid-unit copy, never a recovered read probability.
conditions.missing_zero: Controlled error copy only: all missing point probabilities become exact zero; still exclude records not MATCHED_READ_SITE.
conditions.high_p_filter: Retain explicit midpoint >=0.9 and evaluate eligible retained records; show original opportunity/eligible/explicit and retained denominators. This one-sided filter is not modkit default confidence filtering.

metrics.unit: read-site, with provider-declared control/modified condition label; no claim of molecular purity or natural occupancy
metrics.brier: Mean (p-y)^2 per class; observed-composition mean weighted by scored records; artificial equal-class mean 0.5*(Brier_control+Brier_modified) only if both exist. Missing class => NOT_ESTIMABLE, never zero.
metrics.ML: N/256 <= p < (N+1)/256; midpoint (N+0.5)/256. Retain native bounds on eligible native points; no confidence-interval interpretation. Unbounded log loss remains INFINITE.
metrics.statistics: Descriptive only. Full set, original subset, all five seeds and all constructs reported. No significance test, outcome selection, caller ranking or biological-replication claim.

software_regression.payload: All remaining source-map fields must match; reject repeated keys even if identical, conflicting keys, missing/extra rows and sample/run/read identity changes. Do not silently deduplicate.
software_regression.historical_boundary: Regression tests are new, not part of original six legal transformations. No claimed RMT advantage; both receive semantically equivalent support.
